remainingUncertainty: Whether an alternate public map service provides parcel geometry for the Bhubaneswar/Khordha locator remains unknown.
nextStep: Revisit through an official Khordha-enabled BhuNaksha viewer or BDA/BMC GIS layer; require schema and server-side geometry/ID allowlist before data retrieval.

officialSources.observation: Official Odisha BhuNaksha plot-map UI with District, Tehsil, RI, Village and Sheet selectors; public selector request currently returned only three district choices, none Khordha.
Official Odisha Bhulekh Map View page links to the official BhuNaksha service and exposes village-map/plot-map entry points.
Bhubaneswar Municipal Corporation says property-tax records are being computerised and GIS maps are used for its city survey; this is local property-tax administration, not public parcel polygons.
Bhubaneswar Development Authority offers a land-use map for 205 villages and a clearly labeled draft GIS-based CDP plan; neither was treated as a cadastral vector layer.
ORSAC describes statewide georeferenced cadastral-level land-use maps; the portal is a state asset/planning system, not verified public parcel vectors for this city point.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Official BhuNaksha shell and public JavaScript were inspected. The viewer uses raster WMS for village/plot display and a plot-info handler whose response can include descriptive records; that endpoint was deliberately not called. Anonymous Levels/ListsAfterLevel for state 21 returned only districts Puri (11), Nayagarh (22), Rayagada (27) as current map-backed options; Khordha was absent. No parcel geometry was queried.
